artifactRecordedMetrics.validationSplit: stratified by clip (train.stratified_split), so validation clips come from the same sitting as training clips

protocols.description: ASL Citizen clips from the official train/val signers as references and training data; the fixed held-out test signers as the test set. Softmax early-stops on 20% of the training signers (whole signers).
caveats: Not the app's camera: studio-style webcam clips from Deaf signers, extracted offline with the app's browser extractor.
Signer-disjoint, so it does measure cross-signer generalization.

protocols.description: Legacy schema-v1 own clips. Each sign was recorded in one continuous block; the first 60% of each block trains, the next 15% is validation for softmax early stopping, the last 25% is the test set. Cosine references are train plus validation.
caveats: One signer, one sitting, so neither signer- nor session-disjoint. Read as an optimistic upper bound.
Each sign was recorded in its own block, so sign is confounded with capture time, posture drift, and lighting.
No 'wait' class: the schema-v1 wait clips were archived as wrong, and the 6 schema-v2 wait clips cannot be mixed in.
schema-v1 does not match the live extractor, so these numbers do not describe the running app.
